answer.summary:
KAFKA-20623 implementation complete: topology description plugin is fully integrated into GroupCoordinatorService with heartbeat gating, exponential backoff, update/delete handlers, and comprehensive test coverage. All 27 tests passing. The implementation includes:

1. GroupCoordinatorService integration with StreamsGroupTopologyDescriptionManager
2. Heartbeat post-processing setting TopologyDescriptionRequired flag when StoredTopologyEpoch != currentTopologyEpoch AND LastFailedTopologyEpoch != currentTopologyEpoch AND backoff not active
3. StreamsGroupTopologyDescriptionUpdate handler with member validation, plugin invocation, and three-path failure handling (success writes StoredTopologyEpoch, permanent failure writes LastFailedTopologyEpoch, transient failure arms backoff)
4. Per-group exponential backoff mechanism (30s to 1h)
5. Wire format converters (POJO ↔ wire)
6. DeleteGroups integration calling plugin.deleteTopology before tombstoning
7. Proper plugin lifecycle management with close on shutdown

Test execution: ./gradlew :group-coordinator:test --tests org.apache.kafka.coordinator.group.GroupCoordinatorServiceTopologyDescriptionTest --offline - BUILD SUCCESSFUL
